Name: PokefyMania
Author: NoodlesofCat
Description:
This mod is a modified version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2529]Pokefy[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12065]Pokemania [/url]that combines the assets from both mods into a single mod.
The mod has a few other minor additions such as allowing you to place Fish Tanks outside, a Pokedex counter and a small "quest" for the player to complete.

I do plan on updating and fixing problems with the mod, however it won't be for a while since I'm quite busy.

[b][color=#980000][size=6]MOD DOES NOT CURRENTLY WORK WITH 1.6
[/size][/color][/b]I'm currently fixing the mod but theres alot of changes to strings and data...
I can upload a temporary fixed version of the mod that just fixes textures if people want that so that the mod is still usable while I go through and fix all the strings, text and data.


Thank you to TheKrominator and StravaJD for making the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12065]Pokemania [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2529]Pokefy [/url]mods respectively.
Thank you also to [url=https://www.youtube.com/@CharlieBarley]CharlieBarley [/url]for using the mod in her [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QgsM5R487wo]Stardew Valley Pokemon playthrough[/url] :)
